final_resume.summary: Software Engineer II with 3 years of backend development experience building scalable Java and Spring Boot microservices in distributed payment systems. Proven expertise in system design, code review, and mentoring; seeking to contribute to Google Cloud's distributed computing and large-scale infrastructure initiatives.

bullets: Reduced p95 latency of the settlement API from 800 ms to 350 ms by implementing Redis caching and optimising distributed system communication patterns.
Architected and deployed 4 Spring Boot microservices to replace monolithic payouts module, enabling independent scaling and reducing deployment friction.
Led code reviews and mentored 2 junior engineers across 2-week Agile sprints, establishing quality standards and system design best practices.
Automated nightly reconciliation reports using Java batch processing, eliminating 6 hours of manual operations work weekly.

profile_improvement_tips: Learn and build a project using Python or JavaScript to match JD language requirements; even a small GCP-deployed service strengthens candidacy.
Gain hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services such as Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, or Firestore to directly align with the role.
Deepen system design knowledge by documenting architectural decisions in your current role and publishing a design case study (e.g., microservices migration rationale).
final_resume.growth_note: Strong Java and distributed systems foundation, but missing 3 of 5 JD programming languages (JavaScript, Python, C++) and no GCP exposure. Recommend upskilling in Python and GCP before applying to maximise interview success.
